University of Music and Theatre Leipzig | The University of Music and Theatre "Felix Mendelssohn Bartholdy" Leipzig (German: "Hochschule für Musik und Theater "Felix Mendelssohn Bartholdy" Leipzig" ) is a public university in Leipzig (Saxony, Germany).  Founded in 1843 by Felix Mendelssohn as the "Conservatory of Music", it is the oldest university school of music in Germany.
Leipzig Synagogue | The ornate Moorish Revival Leipzig Synagogue in Leipzig, Saxony, Germany, was built in 1855 by German Jewish architect Otto Simonson who had studied under Gottfried Semper, architect of the Semper Synagogue in Dresden.
Guillermo Pineda | Luis Guillermo Pineda Rodas (born 1984, Guatemala) is a global studies expert, social scientist and entrepreneur.
